title: 'Cyborg 009: Nemesis' Reveals Additional Cast
content: The official website of the Cyborg 009: Nemesis anime series revealed additional cast and a new visual (pictured right) on Friday. The anime adapting Shoutarou Ishinomori 's action sci-fi manga will begin streaming in Summer 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Film Reveals Returning Main Cast
content: ufotable revealed returning cast on Saturday for the anime film of Type-Moon 's visual novel PC game Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ). title: 'Mahoutsukai no Yoru' Announces Main Cast
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) for the anime movie adaptation of Type-Moon 's Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) visual novel announced main cast on Saturday. Produced by ufotable , the film is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Detective Conan' Voice Actress Wakana Yamazaki Dies at 61
content: Voice actress Wakana Yamazaki , known for playing Ran Mouri in Detective Conan , died on April 18 due to an illness. She was 61 years old. A funeral service was held by her close relatives.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power Anime Unveils New Trailer, Additional Cast
content: The Oblivious Saint Can’t Contain Her Power anime unveiled a new trailer on Friday featuring two additional cast members. Shunichi Toki and Inori Minase join the cast as Theodore and Melissa, respectively. The anime is slated to release this July.
author: Anime Corner

title: 40 Years Later, Forgotten Shonen Series Is Returning With a New Release
content: The Spring 2026 anime season is almost here, and Netflix has a new slate of exciting anime series to be added to the platform every month. While Crunchyroll’s seasonal lineup includes dozens of new ongoing series, Netflix often focuses on unique originals or reviving older anime.
author: ComicBook

title: GATE Season 2 Reveals New Key Visual
content: The upcoming GATE Season 2, titled GATE 2: Tides of Conflict revealed a new key visual. The anime premieres in 2027 and according to producer Hattori of Studio M2, the scripts for all the episodes were already complete in December 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: Crunchyroll Manga Adds 24 Titles in New May 2026 Update
content: Launched in 2017, the streaming platform Crunchyroll has risen through the ranks to become the biggest hub for anime fans across the globe. Naturally, this means that a large plethora of anime series can be found on the platform, including new ones that are being released every week.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Years Later, Netflix Will Finally Stream My Hero Academia’s Missing Season
content: In December last year, fans bid a bittersweet farewell to My Hero Academia ‘s anime nine years after its debut. It took the anime series a little more than a year after the manga finale to wrap up the story following the aftermath of the Final War.
author: ComicBook

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Series Unveils New Update Ahead of Anime Debut
content: Almost a decade later, a forgotten Shonen Jump classic will be returning with its anime revival this year. The Black Torch manga by Tsuyoshi Takaki was serialized in the Jump SQ magazine of Shueisha from 2016 to 2018.
author: ComicBook
